name: fastmail
title: Fastmail
description: Search Fastmail email, read messages, open attachments, and copy login codes with a hotkey or from the menu bar.
author: marckohlbrugge

commands.name: search
commands.title: Search Email
commands.subtitle: Fastmail
commands.description: Show your latest inbox emails, or search across all mail.

commands.name: copy-latest-code
commands.title: Copy Latest Login Code
commands.subtitle: Fastmail
commands.description: Copy the code from the newest login email of the last 15 minutes. Prefers the site open in your browser. Assign it a hotkey.

commands.name: login-codes
commands.title: Login Codes
commands.subtitle: Fastmail
commands.description: Show fresh login codes in the menu bar. Click one to copy it.

preferences.name: useAI
preferences.title: Raycast AI
preferences.label: Use Raycast AI to find login codes
preferences.description: Off by default. When on, the subject, sender and text of recent emails that look like login or verification emails are sent to Raycast AI to find the code or link. These emails contain live login codes. When off, codes are found on your Mac with pattern matching only. Requires Raycast Pro.
